BLOB_SX

Absolute Address:

Source:

Description

Sum of X coordinates of all foreground pixels in the blob selected by BLOB_ADDR. Centroid X = BLOB_SX / BLOB_COUNT_RD. Valid when STATUS.FRAME_DONE = 1. Reading may auto-increment BLOB_ADDR when CTRL.BLOB_ADDR_AUTOINC = 1.
